answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before it can earn, with the bond growing for each extra identity funded from the same source. Splitting shale into a thousand flakes is cheap; funding a thousand separate bonds is not. A jade seal or a saffron marker costs nothing to copy, but a slashable bond ties up real capital per sybil, and one proven fraud burns every linked bond at once, so multiplying identities multiplies the attacker's loss instead of the reward.
